about.title: Backend engineering and AI-powered applications.
about.copy:
I am a final-year B.Tech Computer Science & Engineering student (2026). I enjoy building secure Django and Django REST Framework backends and LLM-powered applications.

I work with REST APIs, JWT authentication, PostgreSQL, Redis, Celery, RabbitMQ, and Docker, and with the Gemini and OpenAI APIs. I am looking for a Backend or Software Engineer role where I can keep learning, adapt quickly, and contribute as part of a team.

Documenting APIs with OpenAPI/Swagger and streaming agent decisions with Server-Sent Events.
Containerizing services with Docker, NGINX, and Gunicorn, and testing with pytest.

projects.title: SaaS Backend API Management
projects.summary: A multi-tenant SaaS backend with JWT authentication (refresh-token rotation and blacklisting), SHA-256-hashed API keys, and Free/Pro/Enterprise subscription tiers with per-plan usage quotas.
projects.challenge: Support multiple tenants and subscription tiers while keeping authentication, API keys, and usage quotas consistent and enforceable.
projects.delivery: Implemented plan-based rate limiting with Redis, and Celery jobs that roll up request logs into daily usage analytics served through dashboard endpoints. Documented the API with OpenAPI 3 (Swagger UI).
projects.impact: Tenants can be issued credentials, held to plan quotas, and reviewed through daily usage analytics.

projects.title: AI – Codebase Research Agent
projects.summary: A Django-based research agent that answers technical questions about public GitHub and local repositories with file- and line-cited evidence, running long research sessions asynchronously with Celery.
projects.challenge: Answer codebase questions with grounded evidence instead of uncited model output, while keeping tool use bounded and traceable.
projects.delivery: Explicit agent loop built on ripgrep lexical code search, kept bounded by iteration and tool-call limits, duplicate tool-call detection, 150-line read limits, and one verifier-driven retry. Findings, summary caches, tool-call logs, and research sessions are stored in PostgreSQL and exposed through Django REST Framework session endpoints. PostgreSQL and Redis run in Docker.
projects.impact: Repository questions become cited answers with a durable audit trail of tool calls and findings.

projects.title: AI – Multi-Agent Customer Support System
projects.summary: A Django multi-agent support system on the Gemini API: a support agent checks orders and delivery status and decides when to escalate, a manager agent reviews escalated cases and decides refunds, and a risk agent returns fraud verdicts.
projects.challenge: Coordinate support, manager, and risk agents so order lookups, refund decisions, and fraud checks stay policy-aware and reviewable.
projects.delivery: Added retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) with ChromaDB so agents search company policy documents before answering, and streamed every agent decision and tool call to a live staff dashboard using Server-Sent Events (SSE).
projects.impact: Staff can watch agent decisions live while policy retrieval and fraud review stay in the loop.

projects.title: Django Views Flowchart
projects.summary: Paste Django urls.py and views.py to generate a clean, interactive API routing flowchart using AST analysis and Mermaid.js.
projects.challenge: Understand how a Django API is wired without reading every file.
projects.delivery: A Django app that parses URL patterns (path, re_path, url, include) and function- and class-based views with Python's ast module, then returns a Mermaid.js flowchart from POST /api/analyze/. The frontend is vanilla HTML, CSS, and JavaScript with no build step.
projects.impact: Developers can paste or upload Django routing code and get an interactive, color-coded routing tree (FBVs, CBVs, includes, and unresolved references).

projects.title: Django Banking API
projects.summary: A Docker-containerised banking REST API with Django REST Framework, served behind NGINX, with Celery workers using Redis and RabbitMQ to run background tasks asynchronously.
projects.challenge: Run a banking API with separate local and production Docker environments and asynchronous workers for background jobs.
projects.delivery: Set up separate local and production Docker configurations with environment-specific settings and a server deployment script.
projects.impact: A containerized Django API with a local/production split and async task infrastructure.
